title: Breeding Machine Translations: Evolutionary approach to survive and thrive in the world of automated evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Using a genetic algorithm to generate adversarial machine translation hypotheses, revealing that automatic evaluation metrics like Quality Estimation (QE) artificially assign higher scores to longer translations regardless of actual translation adequacy.

Applying genetic algorithms with mutation and crossover operations on machine translation outputs to demonstrate that neural evaluation metrics (e.g., COMET, QE) systematically favor spurious named entities, adjectives, and rare words while exhibiting blind spots to meaning-changing errors and dropped negations.
